name: Puravankara Ltd
title: Puravankara Ltd - 532891 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Presales hit record INR7,407 crores (+55%) with Q4 at INR3,547 crores, but collections lag and interest cost rose to about INR600 crores while net debt is INR2,321 crores; FY27 targets INR11,200 crores presales and INR750 crores debt cut.

triggers.label: Realisation up 37% to INR11,787/sq ft
triggers.quote: Average realization also improved significantly by 37% year-on-year to INR11,787 per square feet

triggers.label: FY27 presales target INR11,200 crores
triggers.quote: We are targeting a presales value of approximately INR 11,200 crores for FY26-27
triggers.highlight: targeting a presales value of approximately INR 11,200 crores

triggers.label: Collections lag sales; FY26 collections +15%
triggers.quote: FY26 collection reached a record INR 4,258 crores, reflecting a growth of 15% year -on-year

triggers.label: Debt reduction target INR750 crores
triggers.quote: we are targeting a debt reduction of approximately INR 750 crores for FY26-27, excluding any incremental borrowing
triggers.highlight: targeting a debt reduction of approximately INR 750 crores

guidance.quote: We are targeting a presales value of approximately INR 11,200 crores for FY26-27
we are targeting a debt reduction of approximately INR 750 crores for FY26-27

red_flags.label: Interest cost ~INR600-650 crores vs net debt INR2,321 crores
red_flags.quote: Interest again, interest is a little bit has gone up because of the incremental debt which we have taken

red_flags.label: Collections growth only 15% vs presales +55%
red_flags.quote: FY26 collection reached a record INR 4,258 crores, reflecting a growth of 15% year -on-year

red_flags.label: Management could not quantify collections or FY27 delivery guidance
red_flags.quote: We have given a guidance for sales and the debt reduction, but collection we have not given
